title: The man Scorpion killed came back in Mortal Kombat
subject: scorpion
description:
Did you ever guess who Noob Saibot really was? 👇

What happened to Bi-Han, the first Sub-Zero, after Scorpion killed him. Spoilers for the Mortal Kombat story.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NetherRealm Studios or Warner Bros. Games. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Bi-Han's body stayed on Shang Tsung's island. His soul didn't.
Quan Chi dragged it into the Netherrealm, just as he had claimed Hanzo Hasashi years earlier.
It came back as a faceless wraith made of shadow, called Noob Saibot.
He appeared in 1993 as a hidden fighter in Mortal Kombat II. His identity wasn't confirmed until Mortal Kombat: Deception in 2004.
Bi-Han's brother Kuai Liang took the name Sub-Zero, and with it, Scorpion's hatred.
Scorpion spent years at war with the Lin Kuei, while the man who actually killed him served Quan Chi beside him.
